scope: ordinary uncompressed unicast Write and WriteFull; full legal geometry, local VC0/VC-credit profile
references: Common 2.0 section2.8 pp77-79: natural byte lanes, masks, all-zero BE and geometry
Common 2.0 Table2-19 p68: statuses; section2.7.8 pp71-72: UPLI timing
Common 2.0 Table2-2 p49 and section2.7.4.2 p52: shared per-port Tag domain
Common 2.0 section5.1.1 pp106-108 and Tables5-29/30 pp137-139: field/half-flit layout

request.data_beats: immutable tuple of exactly N unsigned512 integers, relative Beat0 first
request.ordinary_zero_be: legal; all Data beats and response still required
request.full_input_be: ignore in this whole-transaction application interface; reconstruct all requested bytes enabled
request.data_halves: 2N low/high256 halves, then one256-bit region BE for ordinary Write only
request.attr_asi_metadata: unsigned8/2/8, preserved opaque metadata; no translation or coherence semantics inferred

response.offset_last: TX zero; RX accepts all width-valid values because unused for Write
response.source: request.dst for debug only; not identity matching

backend: finish(token,*,status=0): execute exactly once and retain response
peek_response(token): response or None until finish
shared_tags: receive(port,tag,kind,status,dst): validate kind, phase, identity, destination, status
retire(port,tag): application completion accepted, identity becomes reusable

known_vectors.method: fixed literals reviewed using an independent binary-field concatenation worksheet; tests do not generate expected words through model encode/decode

local_memory_policy: ByteMemory owns immutable bytes, full57-bit base address and execution count.
Every valid memory_write invocation counts one attempt, including zero-BE and error results.
Status0 updates enabled bytes only; invalid address interval yields status3; every error leaves bytes unchanged.
Explicit nonzero backend status takes priority over local address decode; this is a reference-backend policy.
Backend accept does not execute; finish produces the effect and response; duplicate/invalid events do not mutate state.
Response capacity remains allocated until retirement; backend finish order may differ from accept order.
limitations: Field codecs do not implement Control packing, credits, CRC, DL framing or RTL timing.
WriteBackend is an event oracle; it does not prove the UPLI next-cycle response rule, coherent ordering or rollback semantics.
ReadWriteTags is a shared identity oracle, not Read payload validation; existing Read model is unchanged.
No compressed request/cache, authentication, poison, multicast, atomic or vendor commands.
No reset epoch, isolation/watchdog or stale-response protection after legal Tag reuse.
All validation exceptions are local diagnostic behavior, not invented wire error codes.
